compliance_target: NIST-2025-0035 / NIST CSWP 50 (2026 Small Business Standards)

core_pillars.mission: The 'Master Label' and Version Control. Establishes the unique Metric Identifier and functional 'Why' through standardized taxonomy.
A system of deterministic text-based map files (SEM, BRG, LDD, DIC, LUT) designed to transform raw data into machine-readable 'Logic DNA'.
core_pillars.risk_mitigation: Eliminates 'Contextual Hallucination' by ensuring AI never guesses the intent or purpose of data.

core_pillars.mission: Real-time, verifiable checks providing objective mathematical proof of accuracy via HITL (Human-in-the-Loop) rails.
core_pillars.risk_mitigation: Prevents unauthorized financial commitments and 'Negotiation Drift' (e.g., Chevy Tahoe/Air Canada precedents).

core_pillars.mission: Uniform standards maintaining consistency across all business units and agentic AI deployments.
core_pillars.milestone: 18 Core Metric Sets including the NIST CSWP 50 Small Business Series (ITW-1016, 1017, 1018).
